_comment: English body for gamma; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Driven by third-party generative models; the product page does not publish a full model list, and output quality and available features vary by tier.
axes.runtime: Runs in Gamma’s cloud, primarily in the browser; generation, rendering and export happen server-side.
axes.local_files: Can upload documents, images and brand assets as input; local files must be uploaded and cannot be read directly from the local disk.
axes.background: Presentation and document generation happens within a session and can be edited or regenerated; there is no background agent that survives shutdown.
axes.tools: Generates presentations, documents and web pages from prompts, exports PPT, PDF and images, and provides brand templates and collaborative editing.
axes.context: Context is mainly the current project, uploaded assets and brand settings; cross-project memory and team knowledge-base capability are limited.
axes.permissions: Commercial use and redistribution of generated content follow the tier and official terms; copyright and portrait rights for uploaded assets are the user’s responsibility.
axes.fit: Fits: turning an outline into a presentable deck or one-page document quickly. Does not fit: precise financial models, complex linked charts or formal layout control.
